title: File:Charleroi - Banque de Charleroi - pendant les travaux "Rive-gauche".jpg
author: Jmh2o
notes: Licence CC BY-SA 4.0 per the Commons file metadata (LicenseShortName), own work. Commons 3840 px rendering downloaded. Rive Gauche project in central Charleroi, Belgium: a deep building pit seen from the street above, with five excavators, two tower cranes, the concrete frame of the underground levels and a crew on a rebar mat. Workers are small and not identifiable. Chosen as the cover and site overview camera: two workers stand at the edge of the rebar slab right above a working excavator's bucket (right half of the frame), and two more stand on a ledge at the top of the pit wall beside an unguarded drop. Machine brand names, rental stickers, shop, bank and IFAPME signs and a banner logo blurred; a shop sign at the left edge cropped out.

title: File:Concrete Pours in Amesbury (16018088633).jpg
author: MassDOT (Massachusetts Department of Transportation)
license: Public domain (Massachusetts government work, PD-MAGov); Flickr Public Domain Mark, verified by FlickreviewR
notes: Public domain per the Commons file page ({{PD-MAGov}}; Flickr source https://www.flickr.com/photos/massdot/16018088633/ reviewed as Public Domain Mark). Commons 3840 px rendering downloaded. Crews pour concrete from gantry cranes on the Amesbury side of the new northbound span of the Whittier Bridge (I-95), Massachusetts. Workers seen from behind or at a distance. Chosen for crane loads: a worker walks right beneath a suspended concrete bucket on the bridge deck. The crane is a temporary gantry (portal) crane, with a crawler crane in the background. Contractor and equipment maker names on the gantry, buckets, vests and a machine, plus a road sign, blurred.
